notes_list.title: One-Carbon Shortening
notes_list.basic_overview: Hunsdiecker reaction provides a diagnostic carbon-skeleton transformation because the carboxyl carbon is removed.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
If an alkyl carboxylic acid derivative gives an alkyl halide with one fewer carbon after Hunsdiecker chemistry, the lost carbon corresponds to the original carboxyl carbon.

MECHANISM & STEPWISE EXPLANATION
The source describes the transformation as: Hunsdiecker reaction provides a diagnostic carbon-skeleton transformation because the carboxyl carbon is removed. The mechanism should be read as activation of the stated substrate, formation of the key reactive intermediate, the bond-making/bond-breaking event described by the reaction, and the stated work-up/product-forming step.

1. Activate the stated substrate with the listed reagent/conditions.
2. Generate the key reactive intermediate or electrophile/nucleophile implied by the reaction.
3. Carry out the characteristic bond-forming, bond-breaking or rearrangement step.
4. Complete proton transfer/work-up and verify the characteristic product.
